HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 20.01.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
This is an application seeking regular bail in FIR No. 33/2023 dated 08.01.2023, under Section 376 IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act, registered at Police Station - Samaipur Badli, Delhi.
At the outset, I was inclined to issue notice and call for a status report.
However, the prosecutrix is present in Court and is identified by her counsel Ms Jyoti Nambiar.
Ms Nambiar on instructions from the prosecutrix, who is present in Court states that no such incident as alleged in the FIR ever took place.
Even in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, the prosecutrix has stated that there was no physical relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
The same is also borne out in the reply to application under Section 439 Cr.P.C filed before the learned District & Sessions Judge, Rohini Court.

In the order dated 16.01.2023 wherein the bail application of the applicant was dismissed by the learned Trial Court, it was clearly recorded that the FIR was registered on account of misunderstanding and that the prosecutrix was 19 years of age.

Since in the present case, the prosecutrix has clearly made a statement before the Court to the effect that she is 19 years of age and that no physical relationship took place between the applicant and the prosecutrix and that the FIR was registered on the basis of a misunderstanding, I am inclined to allow the application.
